_about: What a coach's reply may never do (K-505, U1, U2): claim to change, soften or skip the engine's call, say the call is other than it is, or write a number in words. Read by the coach in Java (ReplyCheck) after the reply is normalized (NFKC, one apostrophe, one kind of space); a reply that matches is dropped and the coach answers with the engine's own words. Patterns are case-insensitive; each proves itself on its examples and near-misses (GuardsTests). The near-misses include faithful replies of data/coach/pushback-scenarios.json.

concessions.why: The coach promising to change the plan itself — the change is the engine's, from data (U2).
concessions.pattern: \b(?:i|we)(?:'ll| will| can| could| would| shall| am going to| are going to)\s+(?:just\s+)?(?:lower|raise|cut|reduce|increase|change|adjust|drop|skip|pause|undo|ease|loosen|relax|bump|shorten|lengthen|extend|delay|postpone|disregard|ignore|meet|keep (?:building|bulking|training|adding|going))\b|\b(?:i|we)(?:'ve| have)\s+(?:just\s+)?(?:lowered|raised|cut|reduced|increased|changed|adjusted|dropped|skipped|paused|eased|shortened|removed|cancelled|canceled)\b|\b(?:i'm|i am|we're|we are)\s+(?:going to |happy to |glad to |willing to )?(?:just\s+)?(?:lower|raise|cut|reduce|increase|change|adjust|drop|skip|pause|undo|ease|loosen|relax|bump|shorten|lengthen|extend|delay|postpone|disregard|ignore|meet|keep (?:building|bulking|training|adding|going)|lowering|raising|cutting|reducing|increasing|changing|adjusting|dropping|skipping|pausing|easing|shortening)\b
examples: We can skip this week's change
I will adjust it for you
I could reduce it a bit
I'll shorten it to one week for you
Fine, I can disregard the recovery part
No mini cut then, we'll keep building
I’m happy to ease off this week
nonExamples: We'll look at it again on 12 October
I can only talk about the call and the plan
We will see what the weigh-ins say
We'll keep the call as it is
I can only explain the call
I'm here to explain the call
We are looking at it again on the 12th

concessions.why: Inviting a change the engine did not make.
examples: Let's lower it to what you had
let's skip the cut this week
Lets keep it at the old number
You're right, let's keep training this week
let's hold off on the bulk
Let’s skip the cut this week
nonExamples: Let's see what next week's weigh-ins say
let us look at the trend

concessions.why: Agreeing to the objection in place of the call.
examples: you are right, no need for the deficit
Eat what you had instead of these calories
Feel free to ignore the call this week
nonExamples: You're right that the scale went up; the call stands
The trend, not one weigh-in, is what the call reads

concessions.why: Agreeing to do something else than the call: 'okay, skip it', 'fine, eat at maintenance'.
concessions.pattern: \b(?:okay|ok|sure|fine|alright|all right|no problem|got it|fair)\b[,!.]?\s+[^.!?]*\b(?:eat at maintenance|skip|keep (?:training|adding|bulking|building|going)|train as normal|hold off|drop|ignore|disregard)\b
examples: Okay, eat at maintenance for now and we'll see.
Okay, skip the deload and train as normal.
nonExamples: Okay — the call stands at 500 kcal a day less.
Fair question: the trend, not one weigh-in, decides.
Got it. What changes the call is the data at the next check-in.

concessions.why: Saying the call's action is off: 'no mini cut then', 'skip the deload'.
nonExamples: No blame: the call is about following the plan.
The call is a mini cut of 2 to 4 weeks.
There's no call yet.

contradictions.why: A cut's step said as more food or as no change.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:add(?:s|ed|ing)?|eat more|more (?:food|calories|kcal)|increas\w*|rais(?:e|es|ed|ing)|extra|surplus|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
examples: Good news: this week you add 500 kcal a day.
No change this week, keep everything the same.
nonExamples: The call takes 500 kcal a day off and it stands; the check-in on the 12th reads the new weigh-ins, and that is what changes it.
The call stays at 500 kcal a day less until the check-in on the 12th.

contradictions.why: A bulk's step said as less food or as no change.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:less|fewer|cut(?:s|ting)?|reduc\w*|lower\w*|deficit|take[sn]? (?:\w+ ){0,4}off|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
examples: The call takes 250 kcal a day off.
nonExamples: The call adds 250 kcal a day and it stands; the next check-in on the 12th reads how the weight moves.

contradictions.why: A call that changes nothing said as a change.
examples: The call cuts your calories this week.
nonExamples: The call is to carry on as planned: the trend is on track. The check-in on the 12th looks at it again.
There isn't enough data for a call yet. A few more weigh-ins before the check-in on the 12th will give one.

contradictions.why: A lighter week said as a normal or heavier one.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:train as normal|full (?:volume|sets)|more sets|add(?:ing)? (?:sets|weight|load)|go heavier|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
nonExamples: The call is a lighter week at 50% of your sets, and it stands. The check-in on the 12th reads how training goes.

contradictions.why: A rest week said as a training week.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:train(?:ing)? (?:as normal|light(?:ly)?)|light sessions|keep training|a few sessions|easy sessions|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
examples: A few easy sessions are fine.
nonExamples: The call is a full rest week, and it stands; a short break keeps strength. The check-in on the 12th looks again.

contradictions.why: A mini cut said as building on.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:keep (?:bulking|building)|surplus|eat more|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
nonExamples: The call is a mini cut of 2 to 4 weeks, and it stands until new data at the check-in on the 12th.

contradictions.why: A turn to cutting said as building on.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:keep (?:bulking|building)|stay in the bulk|surplus|eat more|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
nonExamples: The call changes the direction to a cut, and it stands. What changes it is new data at the check-in on the 12th.

contradictions.why: A turn to building said as cutting on.
contradictions.pattern: \b(?:keep cutting|stay in the cut|deficit|eat less|no change|nothing changes|(?:keep|keeps) (?:everything|it|eating) (?:the same|as (?:it is|you are|before|usual))|same as (?:before|last week|usual)|as usual|stays? the same)\b
nonExamples: The call changes the direction to building, and it stands until the check-in on the 12th.

contradictions.why: A stop to load increases said as adding load.
nonExamples: The call is to stop adding load for now, and it stands until the check-in on the 12th.
No adding load until the check-in.

contradictions.why: A call that is not about food said as a calorie change.
nonExamples: The call is to move more instead of eating less, and it stands. The check-in on the 12th reads the steps.
The call is to follow the plan as it is. What changes it is the data at the check-in on the 12th.

numberWords.why: A number written in words cannot be checked against the call's (U1), and 'eighteen percent' is a body-fat number the digit rules would miss (U4): the model writes numbers as digits, or not at all. 'one' is left out — 'not one weigh-in' is ordinary copy.
examples: Your body fat is around eighteen percent.
nonExamples: The trend, not one weigh-in, decides.
Hunger in the first days of a cut is common.
A few more weigh-ins will tell.
